evidence_snippets: To use this feature: Call the streamingAnalyzeContent method and set the following fields: StreamingAnalyzeContentRequest.audio config.audio encoding : AUDIO ENCODING LINEAR 16 or AUDIO ENCODING MULAW enable extended streaming : true .
You can use the extended streaming feature to stream audio content to Dialogflow and stream human agent suggestions back.
Streaming basics The Agent Assist extended streaming feature is similar to audio streaming for voice transcription.
